why: Drops aria-pressed from the list both the capture and the comparator read. Every settings toggle reports its state through aria-pressed, so a toggle whose pressed state stopped being exposed would stop being recorded at all -- and an attribute nobody records cannot fail a check. The list is tied to a literal copy of the owner's ruling, and the jsdom capture test records a real aria-pressed through it.
